<h1 align="center">Glade</h1>

<p align="center">
  A private neobank on Robinhood Chain, for people and the AI agents they run.
</p>

<p align="center">
  <a href="https://useglade.org">useglade.org</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://docs.useglade.org">Docs</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://x.com/usegladeorg">@usegladeorg</a>
</p>

Every Glade payment settles on Robinhood Chain, where anyone can confirm it took place. The amount is encrypted, so only the sender and the recipient can read it. You keep your own keys, and the key that reveals your balance stays on your device.

Agents get accounts of their own. You set the limits, and the chain holds them to it, so your agent can't overspend.

## Repositories

| Repo | What's inside |
|---|---|
| [glade-frontend](https://github.com/usegladeorg/glade-frontend) | The website and the Glade app, built with Next.js and Supabase. |
| [glade-smart-contracts](https://github.com/usegladeorg/glade-smart-contracts) | The Solidity protocol, built with Foundry: confidential USDG, the account registry and `.glade` handles, agent policies, request-to-pay and fees. |
| [glade-documentation](https://github.com/usegladeorg/glade-documentation) | The source of [docs.useglade.org](https://docs.useglade.org), from one transfer traced end to end through to the threat model. |
